description: Fixed evaluation set for F11. Every reference answer is derived from documents/company_handbook.md or from data/company.db as built by scripts/seed_db.py, so ground truth is verifiable, not invented.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee receive per year?
questions.reference: A full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to national public holidays.

questions.question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night for a stay in London?
questions.reference: Hotel accommodation in London is capped at 260 EUR per night.

questions.question: What is the first response target for a severity 1 support ticket?
questions.reference: A severity 1 ticket, meaning a production outage, gets a first response within 1 hour, 24/7.

questions.question: What is the annual professional development budget per person?
questions.reference: Each person has a professional development budget of 2,000 EUR per year, covering courses, conferences and certifications.

questions.question: How many employees work in the Data Science department?
questions.reference: Three employees work in the Data Science department.

questions.question: What is the average first response time in minutes for severity 1 tickets?
questions.reference: The average first response time for severity 1 tickets is 40 minutes.

questions.question: How many support tickets are still unresolved?
questions.reference: Two support tickets are still unresolved.

questions.question: What is the sum of all prime numbers below 100?
questions.reference: The sum of all prime numbers below 100 is 1060.

questions.question: What is 2 raised to the power of 40, divided by 7, rounded to two decimal places?

questions.question: How many customers have churned, and what uptime does our contract commit us to?
questions.reference: Three customers have churned, and the contractual uptime commitment is 99.9% measured monthly.

questions.question: How many employees are in the Engineering department, and how many annual leave days do they get?
